paragraphs.text: The Reef pirates are zombie corsairs on the seas of Ulgrotha .

They are led by a man named Zeki , knowledgeable about the ways of the waters and the seeking of treasures. He knows the uses, and dangers, of sea kelp , the threat of the sea trolls , as well as what happens in Baron Sengir 's vault of horrors. He battles over the oceans of Ulgrotha with the sea dwarves and sees his zombie crew as clearly superior to those of the dwarves.
